dogecoin.text:
@dogecoin_empire 【1Co6:18】Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a person commits is outside the body, but the sexually immoral person sins against his own body.

Our bodies should be holy, and only then can sex be holy. Only in this way can you have a holy and pure love.

@dogecoin_empire Sexual fornication is a sin imposed upon oneself. It is the destruction of one's own dignity and morality, and the making of oneself to be disrespected by others. Ultimately, you yourself will also detest and disrespect yourself, and your spirit will be completely destroyed.
